summary: Implemented TimeElapsedColumn and related changes, but nothing was run. Changes: rich/progress.py (new TimeElapsedColumn between BarColumn and TimeRemainingColumn; Task.finished_time field; finished now means finished_time is present; capture in update and advance; clear in Task._reset and reset), rich/default_styles.py (progress.elapsed yellow), rich/palette.py (Palette.__rich__ with lazy imports and TYPE_CHECKING table import), CHANGELOG.md (Unreleased/Added entry), tests/test_progress.py (test_time_elapsed_column; TimeElapsedColumn added to test_columns list and its expected output regenerated by hand trace), tests/test_palette.py (test_rich_cast). Not run: the test suite was not executed, per instructions. The test_columns expected output was derived by tracing clock reads by hand: frame-0 elapsed 0:00:37 and 0:00:36, frozen finished values 0:01:00 and 0:00:45, bar widths 25 and 16, bar speed now 1 byte/s. Bar run counts were checked by grep. Existing tests test_track, test_progress_track, test_render, test_progress_max_refresh and test_reset were reasoned unaffected, not run. Assumes a non-dumb terminal. Nothing committed.
